patch_description: Structural redesign as a two-branch composition: (A) a percentile-blended 3-scale Savitzky-Golay kernel bank (half-widths sg/2, sg, 2·sg) weighted by Gaussian kernels centered at the 20/50/80th percentiles of local robust volatility, and (B) an RTS-smoothed 2-state Kalman whose smoothed slope gates a small lead compensation (RTS-slope lead) to reduce lag. Outputs are blended and passed through the localized reversal-suppression hysteresis. This decouples "smoothing strength" (kernel bank) from "responsiveness" (slope-gated lead), modularizing each objective into its own stage instead of the monolithic Kalman+hysteresis chain.
